associates.reassignment_impact: Leadership coverage continues through the opening leader
Home customer assistance runs with one fewer associate during the response
The service desk remains open with its other scheduled associate
Outdoor coverage drops to its scheduled minimum during the response
The active loss-prevention observation would be abandoned
The active pickup recovery commitment would lose coverage

spill.resource: Nearest spill kit and wet-floor barriers
immediate_controls: Keep customers outside the affected floor area
Place visible slip-hazard barriers before cleanup begins
Have the responder identify the substance before selecting cleanup materials
escalation_conditions: Escalate immediately if the substance is unknown, hazardous, spreading, or contacting a person
Use the store emergency procedure if the area cannot be controlled safely

immediate_controls: Create a visible boundary around the obstruction
Redirect customers to an unobstructed route
Remove the obstruction only when it can be handled without creating another hazard
escalation_conditions: Escalate if the obstruction is unstable, heavy, sharp, electrical, or blocks an emergency route

damaged_fixture.resource: Portable safety barriers and fixture lockout tag
immediate_controls: Keep customers outside the fixture fall zone
Prevent use or movement of the damaged fixture
Route traffic around the controlled area
escalation_conditions: Escalate if the fixture is unstable, energized, leaking, or cannot be isolated

immediate_controls: Treat visible smoke or flame as a life-safety event
Keep people away from the affected area
Follow the store emergency procedure without waiting for image certainty
escalation_conditions: Contact emergency services and begin evacuation when required by the store emergency procedure
Do not direct an associate to fight a fire unless policy, training, and conditions explicitly permit it

possible_injury.resource: First-aid kit and store emergency procedure
immediate_controls: Protect the person from additional hazards without moving them unless immediate danger requires it
Send a trained responder and keep the surrounding area clear
Follow the store emergency procedure for medical escalation
escalation_conditions: Contact emergency services for serious, worsening, or uncertain medical conditions
Do not diagnose an injury from the image

immediate_controls: Keep associates and customers away from the observed concern
Notify the manager on duty
Use non-confrontational store security procedures
escalation_conditions: Contact emergency services for an immediate threat
Do not identify, profile, pursue, or confront a person from image evidence

immediate_controls: Use a conservative temporary boundary around the uncertain condition
Send a qualified associate to verify the scene in person
Keep customer traffic away until the condition is classified
escalation_conditions: Escalate when the on-scene responder finds a life-safety, medical, fire, electrical, chemical, or security risk
